dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature fitted to a smooth spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a wide pixel radius at the fin's maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness of the anterior margin relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.5:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a medium radius fitted to the anterior-dorsal boundary, partially obscured by luminance bloom.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum profile with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1:1 visible from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle where the anterior melon slope transitions into the horizontal rostrum.
